p: Represents a font wrapper that provides an abstraction layer over SkiaSharp's SKFont, allowing users to work with fonts without directly depending on SkiaSharp.
(float) { get; set }: Gets or sets the size of the font in points.
Measures the dimensions of the specified text when rendered with this font.

ul.li: A rectangle representing the bounds of the text.

p: Creates a new Font instance with the specified size while keeping the same typeface.

ul.li: size (float): The new size for the font in points.
